# oblique_user_profile (Resource)

User profile is a singleton resource that's automatically created for all users and can be edited and managed separately.

https://google.aip.dev/156

As a general rule, information that is available when listing all users is on the User message, information that is only displayed when viewing an individual user's page is on the UserProfile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Profile data for a user — biography, pronouns, location, time zone, etc.
# This is separate from the core oblique_user resource because profile fields
# are often sourced from a different system than the primary directory.
#
# Profile management is inherited from the parent user: the user must be
# under Terraform management for the profile to be managed through Terraform
# too. Here we manage the user from this same configuration so the profile
# can be managed alongside it.
resource "oblique_user" "janedoe" {
  display_name = "Jane Doe"
  email        = "janedoe@example.com"
}

resource "oblique_user_profile" "janedoe" {
  parent    = oblique_user.janedoe.name
  about     = "Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team"
  pronouns  = "she/her"
  location  = "San Francisco, CA"
  time_zone = "America/Los_Angeles"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `about` (String) Longer description.
- `location` (String) Business location, such as "San Francisco".
- `name` (String) Format: `users/{user}/userprofile`
- `parent` (String) The parent of the resource.
- `pronouns` (String) Preferred pronouns. "he/him", "they/them".
- `time_zone` (String) IANA TZ codes "America/Los_Angeles" or "Europe/London".

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Create and update timestamps.
- `delete_time` (String) User profiles can only be soft-deleted to preserve logs and history. If this field is present, the user has been deleted and this profile can't be updated and won't be returned in lists.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `management` (Attributes) How this profile is managed. Inherited from the parent user: profiles of Terraform-managed users are themselves Terraform managed and can only be updated through the Terraform provider; manage the parent user to change this. Omitted from responses when the parent user is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `reporting_chain` (List of String)
- `reports` (List of String)
- `update_time` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the resource is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce TERRAFORM; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
